paragraphs: R' Yaakov, brother of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.
Mentioned in Sanhedrin 76a, raising an objection to R' Ilaa’s statement.[^1][^2]

notes.text: עו. gives Sanhedrin 76a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.

מתקיף means raises an objection; the notice supplies no further argument. Yaakov is the brother of Rav Acha bar Yaakov and the understood objector to Ilaa’s statement. Acha’s Rav is full, but the brother’s title and Ilaa’s remain R'; no title is transferred through the family relationship.
